prompt:
一张高真实感、近距离、俯拍视角的中系室内私拍人像写真，一位成年东亚女性，上半身近景构图，人物微微前倾，抬头看向镜头，脸距离镜头很近，形成轻微广角透视与亲密感，整体是生活化抓拍氛围。

人物拥有黑色短直发，长度到锁骨上方，发质顺滑有自然光泽，额前是轻薄空气刘海，发缝清晰，头发自然垂落在脸颊两侧，右侧头发别着一个银色蝴蝶/花朵造型发夹，带有一点水钻或半透明装饰感；耳朵上佩戴精致小巧耳饰，其中一侧可为粉紫色小吊坠耳环，另一侧为细小耳钉或简约耳饰。

人物脸型为圆润偏鹅蛋脸，五官清秀幼态但明确成年，眼睛大而圆，瞳孔清透，带明显高光，眼神直视镜头，睫毛自然，带淡淡卧蚕，眉毛纤细自然，鼻头小巧，嘴巴微微鼓起，做出鼓嘴朝掌心轻轻吹气的动作，神态可爱、轻微无辜、带一点撒娇感。皮肤白皙细腻，保留真实皮肤纹理与微弱反光，不要过度磨皮。

人物一只手平摊托在嘴前，掌心向上，手上有少量透明水珠或亮晶晶液体反光，像是刚接住一点水或在做轻吹手心的动作。手掌位于画面中央靠前位置，因为距离镜头近而略有透视放大效果。

服装为一种中系居家私拍混搭造型：内层穿白色蕾丝边吊带内搭/文胸式上装，有细肩带、柔软蕾丝花边、胸前蝴蝶结细节；外层是浅粉底色、蓝色大花印花的中式家居风薄外搭/披衫/轻薄开衫，衣服从肩头自然滑落，露出锁骨、肩膀与内搭，营造轻松、随意、生活化的私房写真氛围。下半身不完全入镜，画面重点集中在胸像到半身区域。

场景是狭小的中式生活化室内环境，可以理解为小店后场、生活通道、换装角落、杂物间一类空间，背景较暗，带一点生活杂乱感。后方可见模糊的中文告示牌、墙面纸张、深色门框、室内陈设，空间局促，真实感强。背景不需要特别整洁，保留一点生活现场感更贴近原图气质。

光线为正面直闪拍摄效果，类似机顶闪光灯或手机闪光灯直接打在人物脸部和手掌上，使皮肤和眼睛形成明显亮点，背景迅速压暗，产生典型的中系私拍、室内随拍、近距离抓拍质感。整体曝光集中在人物脸部和上半身，背景较暗，带轻微硬阴影，但人物肤色仍然干净通透。

画面风格偏真实摄影、中系私拍、生活感抓拍、宅家随拍、近距离亲密视角，不是影棚大片，也不是强电影感柔焦，而是更像朋友近距离抓拍下来的真实瞬间。强调真实镜头感、轻微闪光灯反差、亲密构图和高复刻人物状态。

promptTranslations.en:
A highly realistic, close-up, high-angle perspective Chinese-style indoor private portrait photo of an adult East Asian woman. Upper body close-up composition, with the subject leaning slightly forward, looking up at the camera. Her face is very close to the lens, creating a slight wide-angle perspective and a sense of intimacy, with an overall casual, candid snapshot atmosphere.

The subject has short, straight black hair, falling just above the collarbones, smooth with a natural shine. She has light, wispy air bangs on her forehead, a clear hair parting, and her hair falls naturally on both sides of her cheeks. On the right side of her hair, she wears a silver butterfly/flower-shaped hair clip with a bit of rhinestone or translucent decorative texture. She wears delicate, small earrings on her ears: one side can be a small pink-purple pendant earring, and the other side a small stud or minimalist earring.

Her face shape is a rounded oval, with delicate, youthful features while clearly being an adult. Her eyes are large and round, with clear pupils and distinct catchlights, looking directly into the camera. She has natural eyelashes, subtle aegyo sal under-eye highlights, slender natural eyebrows, a petite nose tip, and her cheeks are slightly puffed as she makes the gesture of gently blowing air onto her palm, with a cute, slightly innocent, and playful pouty expression. Her skin is fair and delicate, preserving real skin texture and faint reflections without excessive skin smoothing.

She holds one hand flat in front of her mouth, palm facing upward, with a few transparent water droplets or sparkling liquid reflections on her hand, as if she has just caught a bit of water or is blowing onto her palm. The palm is positioned in the center-front of the frame, slightly exaggerated in perspective due to its closeness to the lens.

Her outfit is a Chinese-style domestic private portrait mix-and-match look: an inner layer of a white lace-trimmed camisole/bralette top with thin shoulder straps, soft lace trim, and a small bow detail at the chest; an outer layer of a Chinese domestic-style lightweight wrap/robe/sheer cardigan with a light pink base and large blue floral print. The garment slips naturally off her shoulders, revealing her collarbones, shoulders, and undergarment, creating a relaxed, casual, everyday boudoir portrait vibe. The lower body is not fully in frame, with the visual focus placed on the bust-to-half-body area.

The setting is a cramped, lived-in Chinese indoor environment, suggestive of the back of a small shop, a utility corridor, a dressing corner, or a storage room. The background is relatively dark with a touch of domestic clutter. Blurry Chinese signage, wall posters, dark doorframes, and indoor furnishings are visible behind her; the space is confined and intensely realistic. The background does not need to be particularly tidy; retaining a bit of lived-in authenticity better matches the mood of the original photo.

The lighting is a front direct flash effect, similar to an on-camera flash or phone camera flash illuminating the subject's face and palm directly, creating prominent highlights on the skin and eyes while quickly falling off into a darker background, producing the typical texture of a Chinese-style private shoot, indoor snapshot, and close-up candid. The overall exposure focuses on the subject's face and upper body, with a darker background and slight hard shadows, yet the subject's skin tone remains clean and translucent.

The visual style leans toward realistic photography, Chinese-style private portrait, lived-in candid snapshot, home casual photo, close-up intimate perspective—not a studio blockbuster, nor heavy cinematic soft focus, but rather a real moment captured candidly by a friend from up close. Emphasize authentic lens character, slight flash contrast, intimate composition, and highly reproduced subject presence.

Framing and Photography Parameter Suggestions:

portrait photography, ultra realistic, photorealistic, close-up portrait, high angle shot, slightly overhead angle, intimate framing, candid snapshot, Chinese-style indoor private portrait, direct flash photography, realistic skin texture, 35mm lens, slight wide-angle perspective, shallow depth of field, upper body crop, vertical composition, 4k, highly detailed
